## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant manual gameplay or browser checks

## Release notes

Apply one or more labels when this should appear in generated release notes:

- `user-visible` for gameplay or interface changes
- `compatibility` for browser, data-file, save, or system requirement changes
- `licensing` for dependency, asset provenance, notice, or distribution changes
- `skip-changelog` only for changes that should not appear in release notes
